prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: 6 hour flight and my leg is crammed into the back of the seat. Only 6'1 and have no leg rm.  why do your seats keep getting smaller?
Delta: ...seats hasn't changed. *ABN 2/2

Customer: Captain Wes Walker came back to welcome passengers thank us for flying and more. Funny guy, great sense of humor. This guy should be the  spokesperson. Take me home Cap’n. Sincerely, ARS, diamond flier. https://t.co/36AYhhlseX
Delta: Wes exemplifies the #DeltaDifference and we are proud to know you get to fly with him. *ASK

Customer: Shocking how  treats their most loyal customers, can’t imagine how they treat normal passengers! They must kick them in the face.
Delta: Again, Michael, I am truly sorry for the experience you had and am disappointed to know that you weren't able to enjoy First Class on your  trip due to an error. Please know we will look further into this to avoid it from happening again. We value you as a Medallion and... 1/2

Customer: - On the final leg of a 4-leg round trip. Last three legs I’ve been seated next to ppl who couldn’t fit in their seats & overflowed into me. Any chance of a complimentary upgrade to delta one for this final leg & positive delta experience?
Delta: Feel free to speak with one of our In-flight Team Members to see if they are able to re-accommodate your seat selection. Tweet us if you need us.  *AJZ

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: service_complaint):
"""- guy from my flight in leg cast just *hobbled* by... good(?) to see you treat all passengers equally (terribly). #nohelpforhimeither"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: We’re sorry you felt that way. Please DM us with your flight details so we can look into this further.
